source_video.prompt: Animate exactly this stylized wolf performing ONE non-graphic death collapse from standing to a motionless pose lying on its side. Preserve exactly the four-leg anatomy, fur, collar pieces, colors, proportions and centered hanging tail. Fixed orthographic side camera, facing LEFT; keep the entire wolf visible throughout the fall, including all paws, head and tail. No camera motion, zoom, cuts, turns or walking away. Begin standing still; the front legs buckle, the chest and hips lower naturally, and the body rolls gently TOWARD THE CAMERA onto its visible side. Legs fold without reversing the elbows; head settles softly on the ground. The tail follows the falling body as one coherent section and settles gently. Finish completely motionless and HOLD the fallen pose for the final two seconds; never stand up or loop. Keep the physical ground height fixed and prevent the body or paws sinking into it. Plain neutral gray background, even lighting. No gore, blood, wounds, explosions, weapons, other characters, scenery, props, text, extra legs or body morphing.

body_roll_policy: Toward-camera native roll with optional lateral limb tuck and head counter-roll; single-side lateral detail authored.

early_collapse_guides.basis: Reviewed early head/chest drop and foreleg folding at reference frames 30,40,50,60. Heights and joint bend are authored native pose guides, not video-measured hidden joints.

fore_contact_policy: Source foreleg flexion retained; anchor/upper/foot solved as three exact sole-height/forward/pitch constraints, with continuous native seed and finite-difference step 1e-5.
trajectory_provenance: Evaluated fitted native skin; not measured hidden video joints.
